Class EnumReaderPair<T,U extends Enum<U>>

java.lang.Object
com.github.jjbcoding.trellis.service.readers.EnumReaderPair<T,U>
Type Parameters:
T - The type or supertype of class objects the reader produces
U - The Enum class
public class EnumReaderPair<T,U extends Enum<U>> extends Object
An EnumReaderPair relates an IReader to the Enum it reads.
